aboutMe.mainBody:
Experienced Developer with over 5 years of experience. strongly motivated by curiosity and want for mastery.
Currently working full time as a Senior Software Engineer for Charter Communications.
aboutMe.subBody:
Data enthusiast who is driven by results, previously graduated with a M.S in Applied Data Science.
Former Data scientist (2018), which shaped many of the approaches I take as a software engineer today.

sicobra.description: Sicobra is the loan collecting branch of the third biggest bank in the country. Worked as part of the predictive modeling unit. Developed a variant of the Montecarlo algorithm to apply a credit score for defaulting users with a 96% accuracy.

cuponCity.description: Cuponcity was an E-commerce company that offered coupons and cashback to users. Participated as an entry level junior developer, member of the FE team in charge of account settings and buy flow.

fairfieldUniversity.description: Fairfield University funded the project Chemquest App which aimed to build a chemistry companion app that could be used as a tool for studying. It also allows users to hand-sketch chemical compounds and it will attempt to predict the isomer using SMILES notation. It integrates with PubMed

charterCommunications.description: Charter is one of the biggest telcom companies in the USA, It serves 32 million users in 41 states. Lead developer of 3 features (as of may 2024). Main lead of Service Appointments which on average has served 104K users with a 98.16% success rate on its flows.
